text:
rachel-docs: opened a docs PR for airgapped installer -> registry certs + KMS hostname rewrite edge cases. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4782

rachel-docs: problem summary: customers mirror container images to an internal registry with self-signed CA. installer bootstrap chroot/containerd fails pulls because CA isn't trusted. also some customers need to redirect public KMS hostnames to an internal KMS endpoint during sealed installs. both need small, explicit snippets and a config option in the installer docs.

lee-eng: thanks. can you add a minimal, copy-paste snippet for containerd and OS CA placement? that'll help support teams. also mention distro differences (debian vs rhel).

rachel-docs: added snippets in the PR. minimal examples included:
```sh
# add internal CA to OS trust store (deb)
cp company-ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/company-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates

# containerd registry-specific CA
mkdir -p /etc/containerd/certs.d/internal.registry.local
cp company-ca.pem /etc/containerd/certs.d/internal.registry.local/ca.crt
systemctl restart containerd

# rhel-like (yum)
cp company-ca.pem /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
update-ca-trust extract
```

pat-ops: for offline bundles we should also document where the installer looks for extra_certs during the squashfs unpack. suggest: `/opt/redwood/installer/extra-certs/` and a small systemd unit that runs before containerd to copy them into the host stores.

rachel-docs: included an installer-config example with `extra_certs_dir` and `kms_host_override` fields:
```yaml
installer:
  extra_certs_dir: /opt/redwood/installer/extra-certs
  kms_host_override:
    - from: kms.redwood.ai
      to: internal.kms.company.local
```

kevin-sre: security note: when overriding KMS hostnames you must ensure TLS is validated. options: 1) issue certs for the internal hostname signed by the customer's CA and include that CA in the installer; or 2) use SNI-aware proxy with a cert that matches the public name and routes to internal KMS. please add both options as pros/cons.

rachel-docs: added short explainer and a one-liner openssl check: `openssl s_client -connect internal.kms.company.local:443 -servername kms.redwood.ai -showcerts` to verify SNI+cert chain.

lee-eng: also add HSM note: PKCS#11 middleware on airgapped boxes may need the kernel `pkcs11` module or vendor driver present in the offline bundle. we hit this with our YubiHSM QA. snippet: `modprobe <vendor-pkcs11-module>` and example `p11tool --list-objects --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`.

emma-cs: customer asked how to rotate the internal registry CA later (post-install). can we add a small playbook: add new CA to extra_certs_dir, restart containerd, pull a test image, then remove old CA once all nodes updated.

pat-ops: add a small troubleshooting checklist to the doc: 1) `ctr images pull` with `--debug` to see TLS errors; 2) check `/var/log/installer/install.log` for chroot mount errors; 3) `ss -lnp | grep 443` on kms host to confirm listener.

rachel-docs: added the troubleshooting matrix and a short example of the installer log TLS error and the matching fix. included a tiny `hosts` override snippet for early-boot chroot: `echo "10.1.2.5 kms.redwood.ai internal.kms.company.local" >> /etc/hosts` (and a note to remove post-cert-provisioning).

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint and linkcheck started for PR #4782.

kevin-sre: lgtm pending small wording tweak about not storing private keys in the installer image.

emma-cs: marked as helpful for the customer who reported this. thanks!

rachel-docs: thanks team  i'll squash and wait for CI + kevin signoff then merge. any final additions?
